impact: Direct hit to NBIS, giving back Wednesday's CoreWeave-driven jump; the capex surge raises funding and dilution worries even though prepayments and contract-backed debt could cover 75% to 85% of 2027 capex.
summary: Nebius reported Q3 revenue of $980.8M, up 571% and above the ~$907M consensus, with adjusted EBITDA of $465.8M and a $37.5M net loss from continuing operations. It said 2026 revenue is tracking at the low end of $3.0B to $3.4B and raised 2026 capex to about $27B, then guided 2027 revenue of $12B to $13B and 2027 capex of $40B to $45B versus about $28.8B expected. Reports say it will drop ARR as a headline metric. Shares fell about 10% to 15% premarket to around $136.
title: Nebius Q3 revenue $980.8M beats, but $40-45B 2027 capex sinks stock ~10-15%
